designPhilosophy: Fine-pitch dovetail XYZ focus sled + clip-on 100× glass doublet lens barrel + 5V warm coaxial LED ring diffuser
summary: Bespoke smartphone microscope adapters with integrated slide stages sell for $99–$149 despite holding a $6 glass doublet lens and basic LED ring. This DIY alternative combines 4 precision-printed optical mounts and a dovetail focus stage with an off-the-shelf 100× achromatic doublet, USB coaxial LED ring, and M3 brass leadscrew for $16.20 total.
assemblyNotes: Print PRT-02 (Doublet Lens Barrel) in matte black PLA+ to eliminate internal stray light reflections along the optical axis.
Print PRT-04 (LED Ring Diffuser) in natural/white translucent PETG with 2 perimeter walls and 15% lightning infill for uniform specimen illumination.
All 4 printed STL parts pack onto 1 single Bambu Lab A1 build plate (2h 08m print time, 110g total filament).

parts.name: Universal iPhone Camera Alignment Saddle
parts.description: Slide-on smartphone saddle with M26×1.5mm optical turret thread centered over the primary camera lens.
parts.roleInAssembly: Registers the optical axis of the doublet barrel directly over the iPhone main camera.

parts.name: Threaded 100× Achromatic Doublet Lens Barrel
parts.description: Baffled cylindrical optical cell with snap-fit retaining lip for the 18mm OD 100× achromatic doublet.
parts.roleInAssembly: Holds OTS-01 glass doublet lens coaxial with the iPhone camera and threads into PRT-01.

parts.name: Fine-Pitch Dovetail Z-Focus & XY Slide Stage
parts.description: 60° dovetail focus carriage with 25×75mm slide recess, bottom condenser aperture, and M3 leadscrew bore.
parts.roleInAssembly: Translates the microscope slide smoothly along the Z-axis for crisp 100× focusing.

parts.name: Snap-Fit Warm White Coaxial LED Diffuser Ring
parts.description: Translucent annular housing that snaps around the lens barrel and diffuses the 5V SMD LED ring.
parts.roleInAssembly: Provides shadow-free ring illumination across opaque and translucent specimens.

parts.name: 12mm Focal Length Achromatic Glass Doublet Macro Lens (100×)
parts.description: Cemented two-element achromatic glass doublet lens corrected for chromatic and spherical aberration.
parts.roleInAssembly: Primary high-NA objective lens delivering flat-field 100× magnification on the iPhone sensor.

parts.name: 5V Warm-White SMD2835 Coaxial Microscope LED Ring + USB Dimmer
parts.description: 8-LED high-CRI warm/neutral white annular illuminator powered from any USB-C bank or phone adapter.
parts.roleInAssembly: Seats inside PRT-04 diffuser ring to illuminate slides and surface specimens.

parts.name: M3×40mm Fine-Pitch Brass Thumbscrew, Anti-Backlash Spring & Nut
parts.description: Knurled M3×0.5mm×40mm brass focus screw with preload spring and captive brass hex nut.
parts.roleInAssembly: Drives the PRT-03 dovetail stage vertically with 0.5mm/rev fine focus resolution.

parts.name: 25×75mm Borosilicate Microscope Slides, Coverslips & Stage Clips
parts.description: Standard 1mm-thick ground-edge 25×75mm glass microscope slides with #1.5 coverslips.
parts.roleInAssembly: Holds biological or material specimens flat in the focal plane of PRT-03.
